fixtureContract.note: Field names and money units were confirmed against a live Cursor account (HTTP 200) by the Phase 6 probe recorded in cursor-usage-auth-probe.md. Three properties are load-bearing: names are camelCase because Connect's JSON codec applies the proto3 JSON mapping to the snake_case descriptor; percentages are used exactly as delivered and never derived, because on the probed account spend-over-limit gave 1078.70 against a reported 23.97; money is minor units, evidenced by limit 2000 for a 20-dollar included allowance. The route is undocumented and is labelled credential-api, never public-api.
